submittedPrompt: I am raising a fund and need a prioritised outreach list. Which family offices can I reach by phone at a named individual, how many are there in total, and for the ones you return, which have every value traced to a statutory source rather than an aggregator? Tell me which to approach first and what is missing from each.
whyThisGoal: No single retrieval call answers this: it needs a filtered shortlist, a separate exact count, per-record evidence grading, and a comparison composed into an outreach order.

limits: Ranks only over released claims. Candidate, held and quarantined values are invisible to this query by design.
Text matching is substring on the firm name, not semantic. A firm whose name does not contain the query text will not appear even if it fits.
Freshness measures when the source was last observed, not whether it changed. An unchanged source is not stale.
Reachability is reported as two separate figures and never merged (ADR-11). Strict excludes personal profiles; profile-assisted includes them under assumption A1, which a reviewer may reject.
No AUM, sector or mandate scoring: most single-family offices do not publish those, and a fabricated band would be worse than a blank.

agentAnswer: I could not honour the constraint of only including family offices, as the dataset cannot express this constraint. Instead, I searched for firms whose name contains the words 'family office' and returned the results. The scope of the search was 242 firms, of which 27 matched the criteria. The top 10 firms that can be reached by phone at a named individual are: Colony Family Offices, LLC, RiverGlades Family Offices LLC, Heritage Family Offices, LLP, Allie Family Office LLC, Duquesne Family Office LLC, Stokes Family Office, LLC, and INTREPID FAMILY OFFICE LLC. All of these firms have every value traced to a statutory source. I recommend approaching Colony Family Offices, LLC first. None of the returned firms are missing any fields.
